evidentiaryIndependenceScope.delimitationOrderScope: Delimitation Orders define assembly constituencies strictly by municipal wards, mandals, and villages, not postal delivery beats.

entries.officialSource: Department of Posts National Pincode Directory & ECI Delimitation Order 2008 (Schedule XXXI)
entries.sourceLocator: Schedule XXXI, Table B, Entries 65, 63, 58, GHMC Ward 78 (Gunfoundry) & Ward 3 part (Sultan Bazar)
entries.referenceDocument: ECI Delimitation of Parliamentary and Assembly Constituencies Order, 2008 (Schedule XXXI, pp. 31-33)
entries.whatSourceEstablishes: The General Post Office (GPO) delivery beat covers Hyderabad central commercial core spanning multiple historic municipal corporation wards.
entries.whatSourceDoesNotEstablish: Does not establish a single unique AC containment; delivery addresses span Goshamahal (AC 65), Nampally (AC 63), and Malakpet (AC 58).
entries.remainingUncertainty: Exact postal delivery route boundary polygon relative to GHMC ward boundaries.
entries.inspectedPassageExtract: Schedule XXXI, Table B: AC 65 (Goshamahal) covers GHMC Ward 78 (Gunfoundry); AC 63 (Nampally) covers Ward 10/11 parts; AC 58 (Malakpet) covers Ward 3 Musi frontage. Hyderabad GPO delivery beat spans across these ward divisions.
entries.directEvidenceVsInference: Direct statutory delimitation evidence establishes that the delivery beat spans multiple municipal wards across distinct assembly constituencies. Single-constituency assignment is factually unsupportable.
entries.unsupportedOrInaccessibleClaims: Statutory 6-digit postal delivery beat boundary polygons are unpublished by India Post and inaccessible. Full multi-hundred page gazette scan is an external publication not checked into git.
entries.identityVerificationConclusion: Candidate constituency names and numbers are authoritatively verified against Delimitation Order 2008 and statutory seed records.
entries.postalContainmentConclusion: Postal delivery beat intersects multiple constituencies without a unique single containment. Fail-closed multi-AC representation is mandatory.

entries.unsupportedOrInaccessibleClaims: Statutory 6-digit postal delivery beat boundary polygons are unpublished by India Post and inaccessible. Full multi-hundred page gazette scan is an external publication not checked into git.
entries.identityVerificationConclusion: Target constituency name and number are authoritatively verified against Delimitation Order 2008 and statutory seed records.
entries.postalContainmentConclusion: Postal delivery area is provisionally associated with the constituency based on municipal ward concordance / post office locality, but spatial containment is NOT proven because postal beats lack statutory boundary polygons.
